title: Cataloging Cuttlefish
statement: Beneath dappled amber sunbeams and swaying ribbon-kelp, this inquisitive little cuttlefish spends its hours sorting smooth pebbles, sea glass, and sunken brass trinkets into neat, gleaming gradients. Whenever a new arrangement feels just right, its skin ripples with soft bioluminescent constellations before it drifts off in search of the next curiosity.
